runtime.scene: DSCF2834 ISO 10000 DR200 night scene with deep shadows

control.statement: The ISO 6400 and ISO 12800 inputs have byte-identical 210510336-byte RAW strips. ISO metadata is the intended model-selector difference.

method.metric: Compute output-minus-input RAW residual, aggregate its 32x32 sensor-coordinate phase means, then measure the first spatial harmonic at one cycle per 32 pixels.

decision.policy: Keep hnnr-stable as the default and cap capture ISO above 6400 to model ISO 6400. Do not silently rewrite nearest-X2D or capture-ISO modes because they are explicit non-HNNR semantic choices.
decision.ui_boundary: State that HNNR safety applies to the HNNR-safe ISO mode; other ISO policies can reproduce model-grid artifacts.

claim_boundary: ISO 6400 is an empirically bounded compatibility selector, not a calibrated noise-equivalent conversion and not a guarantee for every Phocus/HNNR version or scene.
